parties: Punjab National Bank (PNB) / PNB Gilts Limited
headline: PNB Gilts Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Punjab National Bank filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or change in shareholding structure in PNB Gilts Limited, the bank's subsidiary gilt and securities broking entity.
detail: PNB filed a statutory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011 with the National Stock Exchange (NSE). Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisitions resulting in a change of control (i.e., acquisition of 25% or more of voting rights, or such acquisition that triggers open-offer obligations). PNB Gilts Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary and a significant gilt and securities-broking entity regulated by SEBI. The disclosure was filed via NSE's corporate actions filing system on 16 June 2026.
